subject.title: [Feature] Re-enable dev channel distribution tag for npm releases

question: Should OpenClaw support a moving-main npm `dev` dist-tag, or should release-channel docs and update guidance make `dev` installs git-only?
rationale: The source and registry gap is clear, but enabling this channel changes package distribution and supply-chain policy, so automation should not choose the permanent release/security boundary.

options.title: Retire npm dev selector
options.body: Update docs and install/update guidance so `dev` is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.

options.title: Design npm dev snapshots
options.body: Add a first-class secure publish path with versioning, approvals, provenance, credential boundaries, rollback, tests, and registry readback before enabling `openclaw@dev`.

options.title: Keep policy undecided
options.body: Leave this issue open as a maintainer-owned release decision while existing dev users continue using the git checkout path.

recommendation.title: Retire npm dev selector
recommendation.body: Update docs and install/update guidance so `dev` is explicitly git-based unless release owners later sponsor npm snapshots.
